title: Belmont Resorts
description: belmontresorts.com Belmont Resorts is a small boutique hotel in McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, operating as Hotel Satovari Pride on the Strawberry Hills with panoramic views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar mountains. It has just 14 rooms across four categories from Deluxe to Premium Gold corner suites with private balconies, mini-fridges and sunrise-sunset views from both sides. Positioned as a value-for-money alternative next to ITC Hotels and Lemon Tree, it offers a pure vegetarian restaurant with Jain cuisine, 24/7 power backup, fast WiFi and free parking. The hotel caters to relaxation, spiritual tourism, trekking and long-term workation stays with tour packages to Khajjiar and Dalhousie.
